title: Every refund request fails with 500
symptom: POST /refunds/{order_id} returns 500 'internal error' for every request

root_cause.summary: The app_settings table has no 'refund_policy' row. load_refund_policy() returns None, create_refund() passes it on unchecked, and calculate_refund_deadline() indexes it, raising TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable.

expected_evidence.grouping: the traceback lines must be ONE evidence entry with the timestamped line that starts it

must_contain: return row[0] if row else None

not_expected: No database errors: the SELECT on app_settings succeeds and simply returns no row
acceptable_fixes: Make create_refund() fail with a clear 4xx/5xx error, or use a default, when the policy is missing
